newsitem.title: USA: US late spot prods mixed after unsurprising APIs.
newsitem.headline: US late spot prods mixed after unsurprising APIs.

text.p: U.S. spot products prices were mixed late Tuesday following new weekly API data showing an unsurprising build in distillates and a moderate draw on gasoline, players said.
November heating oil futures held steady in after-hours ACCESS trade after slipping about a half cent in both centers earlier in the day amid weaker diffs and lower NYMEX values.
API data for the week ending Oct 4 showed distillate stocks growing 1.3 million barrels, on the low side of normal for this time of year, players said.
Gasoline on the ACCESS screen got a 0.30 cent bounce from API data showing a 810,000-barrel draw, with diffs on most New York Harbor grades little changed for the day.
But Gulf Coast conventional unleaded M3-grade gasoline and reformulated A3 slid over 1.0 cents in line with weakening differentials -- giving up more than half of Monday's strong diff gains.

Gulf prices had firmed Monday on reports of problems at a British Petroleum catcracker in Louisiana, helped by scheduled turnarounds at Sun Co's refinery in Marcus Hook, Penn., and at Amerada Hess' refinery in St. Croix.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
